sources.title: Llama AI Models: Everything You Need to Know
sources.snippet: What is Meta Llama? Meta Llama (Large Language Model Meta AI) is a series of large language models (LLMs) developed by Meta, designed to offer powerful AI capabilities with free-weight accessibility. Unlike closed-source models such as GPT-4 and Claude, Llama allows researchers, AI LLM developers, and businesses to integrate, modify, and fine-tune AI models based on their specific requirements ...
